name: sessions-by-user-endpoint
prompt: Support needs to answer 'what sessions does user X hold'. Add a GET /sessions endpoint in main.go: with a user query parameter it answers a JSON array of that user's live sessions (only live ones; expired excluded), sorted by Created ascending; without the user parameter it answers 400. Add the backing method func (s *Store) SessionsForUser(user string) []Session to session.go (sorted the same way, expired excluded). Register the route in main.go.
